gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of a high-grade glioma (WHO grade 3 or grade 4).

candidate_evidence.quote: NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 1·50 x 10⁸ NSCs loaded with1·875 x viral particles administered intra-tumorally on Day 0 and Day 15

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Repeated Neural Stem Cell Based Virotherapy for Newly Diagnosed High Grade Glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: stem cell-delivered conditionally replicative oncolytic adenovirus

role_evidence.quote: standard chemoradiotherapy will be initiated consisting of daily radiotherapy (2 Gy per fraction x 30 fractions) and concomitant temozolomide (TMZ) chemotherapy

coder_notes: High-grade glioma (WHO grade 3 or 4); glioblastoma not named in conditions, title, eligibility or arms. Only investigational agent is a cell-based oncolytic virus. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it (named standard chemoradiation).
